title: Adversarial Defense in Cybersecurity: A Systematic Review of GANs for Threat Detection and Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2509.20411v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning-based cybersecurity systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, while Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) act as both powerful attack enablers and promising defenses. This survey systematically reviews GAN-based adversarial defenses in cybersecurity (2021--August 31, 2025), consolidating recent progress, identifying gaps, and outlining future directions. Using a PRISMA-compliant systematic literature review protocol, we searched five major digital libraries. From 829 initial records, 185 peer-reviewed studies were retained and synthesized through quantitative trend analysis and thematic taxonomy development. We introduce a four-dimensional taxonomy spanning defensive function, GAN architecture, cybersecurity domain, and adversarial threat model. GANs improve detection accuracy, robustness, and data utility across network intrusion detection, malware analysis, and IoT security. Notable advances incl

translated_title: 网络安全中的对抗防御：基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的威胁检测与缓解系统性综述
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的网络安全系统极易受到对抗性攻击，而生成对抗网络（GANs）既可作为强大的攻击工具，也可作为有前景的防御手段。本综述系统性地回顾了网络安全领域基于GAN的对抗防御研究（2021年至2025年8月31日），整合了最新研究进展，识别了现存研究空白，并展望了未来发展方向。研究采用符合PRISMA规范的系统性文献综述方案，检索了五个主要数字文献库，从829条初始记录中筛选出185篇经同行评审的研究，并通过定量趋势分析和主题分类法构建进行综合分析。本文提出了一个涵盖防御功能、GAN架构、网络安全领域和对抗威胁模型四个维度的分类体系。研究表明，GANs在网络入侵检测、恶意软件分析和物联网安全等领域显著提升了检测准确率、鲁棒性和数据可用性。显著进展包括……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文采用符合PRISMA规范的系统性文献综述方法，分析了185篇相关研究，提出了涵盖防御功能、GAN架构、网络安全领域和对抗威胁模型的四维分类体系，系统总结了2021至2025年间GAN在网络安全对抗防御中的研究进展、现存空白与未来方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a PRISMA-compliant systematic review of 185 peer-reviewed studies on GAN-based adversarial defenses in cybersecurity, introducing a four-dimensional taxonomy spanning defensive function, GAN architecture, cybersecurity domain, and adversarial threat model, while consolidating advances from 2021 to 2025 and outlining future research directions.
